1.
Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of accordingly.

3. The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR No. 623/2018 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC registered at P.S. Ghazipur, East Delhi and all other consequential proceedings emanating therefrom, including the chargesheet pending before the court of competent jurisdiction.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the parties arrived at a settlement vide Settlement Deed dated 20.09.2021 before Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi.
